slider.title: Home Page Slider
slider.pageSubtitle: Manage your home page slider images and content
slider.altTextDescription: This text will be used as the alt attribute for the image and for accessibility.
slider.orderDescription: Order determines the display sequence. Lower numbers appear first.

slider.linkUrlDescription: If provided, the slide will have a clickable button linking to this URL.

slider.mobileVideoDescriptionCreate: Optional portrait clip for small screens (e.g. 9:16). Only used if you also upload a main video; otherwise leave empty.
slider.imageDescription: Leave empty to keep the current image. On video slides, a new image updates the poster only and does not remove the video. Recommended size: 1920x1080 pixels. Max 10MB.
slider.imageDescriptionCreate: Recommended size: 1920x1080 pixels. Max 10MB. This image is required for non-video slides.
slider.videoDescription: Leave empty to keep the current video. A new upload replaces only the video file; the existing poster image is kept. Supported formats: MP4, WebM, OGG. Max 100MB.
slider.videoDescriptionCreate: Supported formats: MP4, WebM, OGG. Max 100MB.
slider.videoNote: Note: If both image and video are uploaded, the image will be used as a poster/fallback.
slider.inactiveSlidesNote: Inactive slides will not appear in the slider.
slider.durationSecondsDescription: How long this slide stays on the home page before switching. Default 5, maximum 600.
slider.copySlideTitle: New slide with the same text and link; upload new image or video
slider.getStarted: Get started by adding your first slide to the home page slider.
